stages.label: Recorded semantic atoms and their meanings
Verbal meanings after prefixes and transformations
stages.operation: redirect an action; express causation, desire, repetition, or intensity
examples: the causative makes an agent cause the action

stages.label: Verbal meanings after two ordered prefixes
examples: सम् + आ + ⟪गम्⟫ produces समागम्, the base behind समागम (samāgama), coming together

stages.label: Actions, agents, instruments, qualities, and obligations
stages.operation: turn verbal meanings into further kinds of meaning
examples: कर्तव्य (kartavya), what ought to be done

stages.label: Quality, state, possession, descent, origin, use, and measure
stages.operation: make a generated noun the input to another relation
examples: कौन्तेय (Kaunteya), a son or descendant of Kuntī

stages.label: Nouns returned to the verbal engine
stages.operation: turn a nominal meaning into a new action

stages.label: Negative counterparts
stages.operation: express absence, non-occurrence, or negation once per eligible meaning

stages.label: Bounded word-meaning subtotal before inflection
stages.operation: add comparison, female-agent meanings, bounded compounds, and one post-compound step

stages.label: Complete declared लौकिक grammatical capacity
stages.operation: carry action meanings through 10 × 3 × 3 and name meanings through 8 × 3; retain unchanging words once
